prior_importants.description: The thread-to-review match reads GraphQL `pullRequestReview.databaseId`, a 32-bit `Int`. GitHub review ids have very likely passed 2^31 by now, so the field can error, which would crash every status recompute, or come back null, which would silently disable the thread-based `raisedAt` check.

A carried important is now released only when the bullet's `[file, line, description]` exactly matches the thread's marker. The marker is built from the posted finding. The bullet is built from `prior_importants`, which the orchestrator model copies by hand from the prior record, again every round. Any drift in that copy means the thread no longer releases the important, so the PR stays `review-open` for good.
ADR 0165 still describes the removed `path:line` / `originalLine` / `Re:` thread match; the PR replaced it with the marker match, per-section release and fail-closed verdict rule.
